settings.about_text: Solana Beauty embodies medical-grade safety, artistry, and effortless beauty. Specializing in advanced lash architecture, micro-pigmentation, lip contouring, and brow sculpting. Every procedure is tailored to enhance your unique natural harmony in an ultra-clean, serene clinical atmosphere.
settings.standards_subtitle: We do not mask your features — we reveal your innate symmetry with sterile precision, cruelty-free materials, and customized contouring.
settings.card_desc_1: 100% single-use disposable micro-needles and hospital-grade air sterilization for your peace of mind.
settings.card_desc_2: Every brow and lip line is measured strictly against your facial golden ratio before any procedure begins.
settings.card_desc_3: Dermatologically tested mineral pigments that heal into soft, natural gradients without blue or red shift.
settings.services_subtitle: Browse our signature aesthetic services. Each section and treatment is customizable in real time.
settings.gallery_subtitle: Authentic, unretouched results from our studio. Tap any image to examine detail in full screen.
